story: Lake Dardanelle State Park is located on two sites in Arkansas, USA, on the 34,300-acre Lake Dardanelle. One site is in Russellville and one is in Dardanelle. Both sites include picnic facilities, boat ramps, pavilions, playgrounds, and dump stations.
matters: The park hosts many fishing tournaments and offers interpretive programs such as guided hikes, nature talks, kayaking, lake tours and demonstrations, evening slide shows, and movies.
name: Lake Dardanelle State Park
